invariants.rationale: The method relies on 'order' being non-null to safely call its methods.
Quantity is usually a non-negative value for an order in typical business logic.
Unit price is expected to be non-negative in a typical order system.
If both quantity and unit price are non-negative, their product (the price) will also be non-negative.
The getQuantity() accessor is expected to return the underlying 'quantity' field.
